title: koeleria pauneroi
intro: Koeleria pauneroi, commonly known as the Argentine Hair Grass, is a species of grass native to South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria pauneroi include its antitussive, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria pauneroi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
